coordinates.values: glTF node-local bone transforms (p xyz, q xyzw), stride 7
coordinates.props: glTF scene space = rig.root local, source metres: origin xyz, axis xyz, up xyz, visible
coordinates.stages: runtime metres in the anchor actor frame (+x right, +y up, -z forward); yawDeg + = turn left
coordinates.contacts: clip seconds; partner parts are contactPoints names; standoffM = runtime metres along the patch normal where the knuckle centroid (finger roots) sits

CareLieWrithe.notes: Alone on the straw in pain: the right knee drawn up and dropped, back arching, rolling to his left and back, the right hand clutching the belly, the left clawing the straw. Loops seamlessly.

CareLieTreated.notes: Lying for a medic: left leg straight and still, right knee up, the head lifting to look at the leg, a flinch at 2.5 s (a pulled wrap). Pairs with CareMedicBandage / CareMedicPress (stages bandage / press).

CareMedicBandage.notes: Kneels at the lying man's left, wraps his left thigh: two wraps per loop, the right hand carrying the roll round the limb, the left holding the turns, a tug at the top of each wrap.

CareMedicPress.notes: Kneels at the lying man's right, both hands pressing a dressing onto his right upper chest, the weight rocking onto the hands; glances up over his right shoulder once a loop.

CareZhouRecline.notes: Zhou half-reclined against the low wall: left leg out straight (bandaged), right knee up, right forearm over the knee, left hand on the thigh. Head neutral: the speaker head layer turns it at runtime.

CareZhouWince.notes: BorrowLight "wince": the leg pulls, he folds forward over it with both hands on the thigh, holds, and breathes back out into the recline (last frame = CareZhouRecline frame 0).

bandage.notes: CareMedicBandage kneels at CareLieTreated's left: medic root = patient root + (-0.40 x, -0.24 z) in the patient frame, yaw = patient yaw - 90 deg.

press.notes: CareMedicPress kneels at CareLieTreated's right: medic root = patient root + (0.42 x, 0.36 z) in the patient frame, yaw = patient yaw + 90 deg.

recline.notes: CareZhouRecline / CareZhouWince: the root 0.43 m in front of the wall face, his back to it.
